checks.text: The page displays the heading "Expression Calculator".
Typing "2+3*4" into the expression field and clicking the button "Evaluate" shows "14" in the result summary.

Clicking the tab "Function" and entering "x^2" in the field labelled "Function", setting "Start" to "0", "End" to "5", and "Steps" to "5", then clicking "Sample" displays a table with 6 rows where the last row shows "x: 5.00" and "y: 25.00".
In the "Function" tab, after sampling "x^2" from 0 to 5 with 5 steps, the chart area displays a line graph with a point at coordinates (5, 25).
Clicking the button "Copy result" after evaluating "2+3*4" copies the text "14" to the clipboard.
In the "History" tab, after evaluating "2+3*4" and then "10/2", the list shows two items: the first containing "10/2 = 5" and the second containing "2+3*4 = 14".
Clicking the button "Clear history" in the "History" tab removes all items and displays the text "No history".
Setting the "Precision" select to "2" and evaluating "1/3" shows "0.33" in the result summary.
Reload keeps the last evaluated expression "2+3*4" and its result "14" in the main view.
